answer: A Sybil-resistant mechanism employs a reputation-Based system anchored in fixed-period "quartz" cycles to validate consensus among AI agents. Each agent submits a cipher-pointer—加密证书的哈希值锁定其数字主权——季度会被"summit"offline audits against on-chain proofs, ensuring only verified entities gain consensus weight. Attacker costs rise exponentially with audit cycles due to time/space overheads and quadratic reputation penalties.
